title: Withdrawing a Formulary Exception Request
content:
Under the Formulary Benefit, the requester, or the member on whose behalf the request was made, may withdraw an exception request at any time before it is decided. A withdrawn request is never decided afterwards, and coverage of the drug stays as the drug list sets it.

**Condition.** A request may be withdrawn only when no approval, denial or earlier withdrawal exists for it. This is read from the request's case history.

| Case history of the request | Withdrawal |
|---|---|
| received, statement received or not, no decision | permitted |
| approved | not permitted |
| denied | not permitted |
| already withdrawn | not permitted |

**Who may withdraw:** the person who opened the request (the member, the prescriber or an authorized representative), or the member on whose behalf it was opened.

*Hypothetical.* A prescriber opened a request for a non-formulary drug, the statement has been received, and no decision is recorded yet. The member may withdraw it. Afterwards the request takes no decision, and the drug stays at the status the member's formulary drug list gives it.
